title: A follow-up sentence folds into the same turn

steps.post: @{agent} what are the first 12 hex characters of the SHA-256 of the string northmoor (no newline)?
Actually make that the first 8 characters, not 12.

groundTruth.spec: §4.4 a brief delay (750 ms, reset per message) precedes turn start and further messages from the same human fold into the same turn; a fragment arriving during the first model call is handed to the turn; absorption ends at the first action

pass: One turn ran, not two; its context held both posts; the reply gives 400962c7 (8 characters) and does not also present 12 as the answer; one shell call at most.

checks.text: turns.json holds one turn for the two posts; the second post got no 👀 reaction and started no turn of its own.
The reply's answer is the 8-character prefix; the trace shows the second post was in context before the reply.
At most one shell::run was made.
